messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-11, the Cinder team owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-04-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-07]
- INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3]
- On 2026-04-14, team Dune noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so the notifier is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
- On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team flagged the reports pipeline as not their service. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- The Boreal team observed that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03-2]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- On 2026-05-28, the Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- On 2026-06-04, the Boreal team noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher's runbook. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
- On 2026-05-22, team Dune noticed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-2]
- Certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, a follow-up decision from the INC-2025-017 review. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]

Question: Who was responsible for the notifier on 2025-05-17?

2. "earlier: As of 2025-06-11, the Cinder team owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]"
